section_summary.extract_value: This section presents mediation analyses examining body appreciation as a mediator between various predictors (discrepancy perfectionism, order perfectionism, attachment anxiety, and restrictive/critical caregiver eating messages) and intuitive eating. Using bootstrap procedures with 1000 samples, three of four indirect effects were significant: body appreciation fully mediated the link from discrepancy perfectionism to intuitive eating and partially mediated the links from attachment anxiety and caregiver eating messages to intuitive eating, while the indirect effect from order perfectionism was not significant.
